calls.title: Aimee Jennings and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on improving the Growth Book podcast's visual appeal and engagement by adding B-roll and overlays to the videos, addressing the current simplicity of production methods used by Ashley Stirrup. Andrew Hunt, with a background in scripted TV editing, supported this approach to enhance viewer retention, especially given the current format showing only two talking heads, which is viewed as visually uninteresting. An ambitious goal was set to produce 20 episodes monthly, with plans to distribute short segments across multiple social platforms and build a microsite for better user experience. The team also addressed inefficiencies in the editing workflow and proposed a pilot episode to test new approaches while discussing budget flexibility and audience education regarding experimentation's value.
calls.keywords: podcast editing, video production, visual storytelling, experiment-driven content, short-form clips, brand integration
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Send Aimee the YouTube link to a current Growth Book podcast episode for review to better understand the format and content (11:40)
Share the Disney Vacation Club podcast episode and a selected short clip segment with Aimee by the end of the week to initiate a pilot editing trial (25:36)
Provide URLs and necessary assets related to featured companies (e.g., Disney Vacation Club website) to Aimee to incorporate into video edits (23:40)

**Aimee Hunt**
Review the full podcast episode and provided short segment(s) to identify creative video editing opportunities for visual enhancement (26:00)
Produce a visually enhanced short clip from the Disney Vacation Club episode using provided URLs and editing resources after receiving materials from Ashley (23:40)
